title: Spanish Paella
description: A classic Spanish dish made with saffron-infused rice, chicken, and seafood. This recipe serves 4-6 people.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, saffron, and rice to the pan. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Serve the paella hot, garnished with lemon wedges.
